Jab aasmaan phat jaaega
Aur apne Parwardigar ka hukm baja laaega aur yeh zaroori bhi hai
Aur jab zameen baraabar kar ke phaila di jaaegi
Aur woh apne zakheere phenk kar khaali ho jaaegi
Aur apne Parwardigar ka hukm baja laaegi aur yeh zaroori bhi hai
Aye insaan! Tu apne Parwardigar ki taraf jaane ki koshish kar raha hai, to ek din us ka saamna karega
Phir jis ko naama-e-aamaal daahine haath mein diya jaaega
Us ka hisaab aasaan hoga
Aur woh apne ahl ki taraf khushi khushi waapas aaega
Aur jis ko naama-e-aamaal pusht ki taraf se diya jaaega
Woh anqareeb maut ki dua karega
Aur Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil hoga
Yeh pehle apne ahl o ayaal mein bahut khush tha
Aur us ka khayaal tha ke palat kar Khuda ki taraf nahin jaaega
Haan, us ka Parwardigar khoob dekhne waala hai
Main shafaq ki qasam kha kar kehta hoon
Aur raat aur jin cheezon ko woh dhaank leti hai un ki qasam
Aur chaand ki qasam jab woh poora ho jaaye
Ke tum ek museebat ke baad doosri museebat mein mubtala hoge
Phir inhein kya ho gaya hai ke imaan nahin le aate hain
Aur jab un ke saamne Quran padha jaata hai to sajda nahin karte hain
Balke kuffaar to takzeeb bhi karte hain
Aur Allah khoob jaanta hai jo yeh apne dilon mein chhupaaye hue hain
Ab aap inhein dardnaak azaab ki bashaarat de dein
Ilaawa saahibaan-e-imaan o amal-e-saaleh ke, ke un ke liye na khatm hone waala ajr o sawaab hai
